verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents a quickstart that sends an email in under two minutes from a sandbox domain, and sending goes through a single POST to the /messages endpoint. SDKs in multiple languages and ready-to-use Postman requests are also documented. A community developer independently describes it as incredibly easy to integrate. Missing for 10: evidence that the send response returns a message id for tracking, an explicit list of the minimal required fields, and visible copy-paste quickstart code in the evidence.
